text:
Maria: quick sanity check — we have customers hitting a mix of 1k x 768 and 50 x 1536 requests and the embed endpoint is returning 413s for the large array batches. thinking through options: auto-split, soft-accept+async, or explicit client error.

Jake: ugh. which 413 path? payload bytes or "dim mismatch" semantics?

Maria: payload bytes mostly but dims vary per item. our splitter currently assumes uniform dims and fails if heterogenous.

Li: long term we should support mixed-dim batches but today we need a safe UX. proposal: early preflight that returns a structured hint with suggested split plan rather than just 413. So clients can auto-split.

David: +1 on giving a split plan. Console should show estimated units for both original and suggested split so users understand cost.

ConsoleUI: we can add a per-request card in the request inspector UI: estimated token units, estimated cost delta, and recommended split suggestions. low risk for rollout behind feature flag.

Priya: behavior question — do we return 200 with a small 'split_needed' body that queues the split, or 413 with guidance? customers using simple SDKs just bubble up 413 and retry logic is messy.

Li: prefer 413+X-Embed-Suggest header for backward compatibility. header carries a compact advice string e.g. "split=4;by=512;hint=client". new SDKs can parse and auto-retry. older clients keep failing but at least we avoid changing success semantics.

Jake: header-friendly but ops: we should not leak policy details. maybe an opaque plan id that the client sends back to an async split endpoint. workflow: request -> 413 + plan-id -> client POST /split/plan-id -> respond with new smaller requests.

Maria: that adds server-side state and lifecycle for plans. extra complexity. I'm leaning to stateless advice in header. short TTL and base64 encode.

David: telemetry needs: record dims distribution, split decisions count, and preflight match rate. want histograms per tenant and per-route.

Priya: also track how many clients accepted suggestion vs manual retry vs gave up. add metric: embed.suggest.accept_rate.

OpsBot: deploy embed-ingress v2.3.1 succeeded to canary (eng-platform-canary). :tada:

Maria: rollout plan: start with header mode behind FF 'embed_split_advice' for 10% canary tenants. console shows flag, metric card for suggest.accept_rate, and cost delta overlay.

Li: small UX nit — header parsing and split logic should consider mixed dims. header encoding suggestion: JSON-ish compact string like '{"plan":[{"count":10,"dim":768},{"count":50,"dim":1536}]}' but compressed. SDKs will unpack.

Jake: smaller suggestion: return a simple CSV-ish tuple: '768:10,1536:50' in header 'X-Embed-Shape-Hint'. easy parse.

Maria: ok that feels succinct. ensure we document in SDK changelog.

David: instrumentation: we should emit an event 'embed.preflight.v1' with tags: tenant_id, route, original_count, shapes, suggested_plan. (for privacy, hash tenant_id in telemetry).

Priya: console visualization: create a new chart 'Shape Mix' that overlays shapes heatmap with a time-series of preflight rejects. link to suggestions table.

Li: also a circuit breaker: if a tenant triggers > N preflight rejects per minute, throttle to fast-path small-batch queue to avoid OOM pressure. we can flip a routing policy to route tenant -> small-fastpath.

Jake: how do we detect fair share? aggregator-level or per-worker? prefer central control plane to flip route mapping.

Maria: agreed. implement a central 'shape-throttle' signal. runtime subscribes and routes accordingly. add audit log entries.

David: question on billing: if we auto-split server-side do we bill original request or the child requests? must be transparent. recommend billing child requests and show 'original request billed-as split' note in console.

Priya: open question: when should we reject vs auto-split? auto-split should be opt-in per-tenant (safety). default behavior = 413+X-Embed-Shape-Hint. opt-in = server-side auto-split with explicit tenant consent.

OpsBot: feature flag 'embed_split_advice' created. owners: @Maria, @Li.

Maria: next steps I'll draft a RFC: split-advice header spec + telemetry + console card. Li/Jake please review for runtime perf implications. Priya/David please add console mocks and metric names. aiming for canary next week.

Jake: will follow up with perf microbench: preflight overhead <1ms per request at 10k rps? I'll run load test and post numbers.

Li: I'll stub header encoder/decoder in SDK and add tests.

David: I'll prototype the console card. Priya can you assist with UX copy for guidance?

Priya: yep. will do copy and add a tooltip explaining the split logic and cost tradeoffs.

Maria: thanks all. going to file RFC and a small PR for header and telemetry event.

Jake: :thumbsup:
